assignment.title: Implement an SPMI Feature from Figma
assignment.description: Build an application feature based on the provided design and ensure it is properly integrated into this application.
assignment.design_description: Use the following Figma design as the reference for the feature you will implement.
assignment.figma_mcp_hint: Use Figma MCP to inspect the design.

steps.repository: Understand the repository's contents, structure, technologies, conventions, and existing implementation patterns.
steps.login: Sign in to the application with the provided credentials before starting the feature.
steps.implement: Review the Figma design, then implement the feature shown in that design.
steps.ai_agent: Use an AI coding agent to support the analysis and implementation process. The repository provides relevant supporting resources.
steps.docker: Ensure the application can be deployed with Docker.
steps.implementations_api: Use the GET /api/implementations endpoint for audit implementation data.

requirements.conventions: Follow the architecture, folder structure, design system, and conventions already used in the repository.
requirements.responsive: Ensure the interface works well at relevant screen sizes.
requirements.reuse: Use available components where appropriate and avoid unnecessary duplication.
requirements.i18n: Use the existing internationalization mechanism for interface text.
requirements.scope: Do not modify unrelated parts of the application.

submission.fork: Fork this repository to your GitHub account.
submission.verify: Ensure lint and build commands complete successfully.
submission.pr: Create a Pull Request so the implementation can be reviewed.
submission.summary: Include the implementation steps taken in the Pull Request description.
